meaning: A good bed — a good marriage, and being well cared for in it
note: From “Obaa ko aware pa a na yede no to kete pa so”: it is when a woman enters a good marriage that she is laid on a good bed.
references: Arthur, G. F. Kojo. Cloth as Metaphor: (Re)reading the Adinkra Cloth Symbols of the Akan of Ghana (2001)
